accent.$description: The single brand accent: links, active states, figures, navy panels (ADR-0003).

accent-pale.$description: Pale accent fill for a highlighted row, tag or state.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill, 14.53:1 on navy.

tertiary.$description: Owner ruling 1, 2026-10-09: tertiary text, captions and footers.

decoration.$description: Owner ruling 1, 2026-10-09: non-text decoration only (axis lines, ticks, icons beside a label), never text.

canvas.$description: Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09: background of every document page (A4 report, paper, slide).

surface.$description: Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09: cards and panels on the page.

surface-alt.$description: Recessed surface: table headers, grouped areas.

desk.$description: Owner ruling 9, 2026-10-09: on screen only, around a page preview; never inside a document.

border-strong.$description: Outline of outlined and dashed state marks in documents (badges, legend swatches), 3:1 or more on canvas and surface for WCAG 1.4.11 (increment 07 component need, ADR-0004: states by mark style).

panel-start.$description: Light end of the navy panel gradient; the worst case for text on navy.

panel-end.$description: Dark end of the navy panel gradient.

title.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: titles, figures and icons on navy.

secondary.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: secondary text and labels on navy.

second-level.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: second-level text on navy.

accent.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: the one-off accent on navy; replaces the retired sky blue.

rule-strong.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: stronger rules on navy (decorative).

pill.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: icon-pill fill on navy (decorative); the icon on it stays white.

discreet.$description: Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09: discreet numbers on navy; 3.44:1, so large text or non-text only.

success.$description: Apps only: success, always with an icon or a word (ADR-0004).

warning.$description: Owner ruling 5, 2026-10-09: warning text, icons and borders; apps only (ADR-0004).

danger.$description: Apps only: errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or a word (ADR-0003, ADR-0004).

info.$description: Apps only: information, always with an icon or a word (ADR-0004).

warning-fill.$description: Owner ruling 5, 2026-10-09: warning badge and highlight fill, always with ink text; white on it is forbidden (2.93:1).

warning-tint.$description: Owner ruling 5, 2026-10-09: warning tint behind ink text; warning strong only for icons and borders on it.

dim.$description: Retired name of the old tertiary grey; resolves to tertiary (Owner ruling 1, 2026-10-09).
dim.$deprecated: Use --mq-tertiary for text or --mq-decoration for non-text decoration.

accent-on-dark.$description: Retired name of the accent on navy; resolves to the on-navy accent (Owner ruling 2, 2026-10-09). Use --mq-on-navy-title for titles and rules, --mq-on-navy-accent for the one-off accent.
accent-on-dark.$deprecated: Use --mq-on-navy-title for titles and rules, --mq-on-navy-accent for the one-off accent.
